<div id="widget-frame-wrapper" style="background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
  <iframe id="statik-frame" src="widgets/widget-bauplan-statik.html" width="100%" height="2150px" style="border:none; display: block; min-height: 1200px;" scrolling="no" allowfullscreen="true" allow="fullscreen"></iframe>
</div>
:::

<script>
  function toggleFullscreen() {
    const frame = document.getElementById('statik-frame');
    if (frame && frame.contentWindow) {
      try {
        if (typeof frame.contentWindow.togglePlanFullscreen === 'function') {
          frame.contentWindow.togglePlanFullscreen();
          return;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Fallback for cross-origin or local restrictions
      }
      frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ action: 'toggle-plan-fullscreen' }, '*');
    }
  }

  // Adjust iframe height dynamically if message received (strictly loop-proof)
  let lastFrameHeight = 0;
  window.addEventListener('message', function(e) {
    if (e.data && e.data.type === 'resize-iframe' && e.data.height) {
      const targetHeight = Math.ceil(e.data.height);
      // Guard against infinite height expansion loops: only resize if difference > 15px
      if (Math.abs(targetHeight - lastFrameHeight) > 15) {
        lastFrameHeight = targetHeight;
        const frame = document.getElementById('statik-frame');
        if (frame) {
          frame.style.height = targetHeight + 'px';
        }
      }
    }
  });
</script>
